channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Norfolk prison recruits Pagan chaplain (but insists they can't get naked)
item.description: A Norfolk prison’s latest recruitment call has raised eyebrows after it revealed it is seeking to employ a Pagan chaplain.

item.title: Play areas to be revamped as part of £1.5m regeneration project
item.description: Seven projects in the Great Yarmouth borough are due to benefit from a £1.5m funding boost, ranging from enhancing play areas to supporting the revamp of the Winter Gardens.

item.title: Dog-walking field approved despite fears escape-minded canines will cause chaos
item.description: A new dog-walking facility has been approved in the Norfolk countryside despite fears animals will escape the premises and cause nuisance.

item.title: Norfolk gentlemen's club accepts women members... and not everyone is happy about it
item.description: The Strangers Club in Norwich has allowed women members to join for the first time in 99 years, leaving just one men-only private members' club in Norfolk.

item.title: More workmen spotted at former Debenhams building
item.description: Labourers have been seen again working on a section of roof at the old Debenhams building in the city.

item.title: Woman charged after attempted cash point mugging
item.description: A woman has been charged after an attempted mugging at cash machine in the city.

item.title: Man launches fight to relocate business to farm after plans refused
item.description: An appeal has been launched to relocate a business to a farm near Dereham after a planning bid was refused.

item.title: Derelict bullpen on Norfolk estate set for new lease of life
item.description: Richard Ellis, owner of Wolterton Park, has submitted plans to North Norfolk District Council to convert the former bullpen on the estate into new offices.

item.title: You don’t need extreme views to make impact on British politics
item.description: One of the great political mysteries of recent years has been the Conservative Party’s veer to the extreme right just Reform UK appeared on the scene.

item.title: Bus shelter saga sees new design which may only retain 'some' of 1950s structure
item.description: Sheringham Town Council has released a statement this week about what is next for the bus shelter off Station Road, with some designs
